dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region to the posterior peduncle at a constant rate.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast dark specks on the anterior dorsal surface and discrete dark pits on the posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of small, dark punctate marks or pits on the posterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible longitudinal dorsal ridge with associated shadow casting on the right flank.
